snippet.title: Wretched Tales: Cinderella — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wretched Tales: Cinderella is a 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure that reimagines Cinderella as a dark fairy tale.

Examine scenes, uncover clues, and use items to solve puzzles. Characters reveal their wants and desires through expressions, actions, and picture bubbles.

A free Windows demo is available on Steam, with support for 14 languages.

The full game is planned for Q1 2027.

Developed by HAEON STUDIO.

#WretchedTalesCinderella #PointAndClick #PuzzleAdventure #IndieGame
